description: Diagnose, generate and fix Casbin model.conf & policy.csv configurations. Explains why enforce() returns false, detects duplicate rules, role cycles and matcher-order bugs.

commands.name: validate_model
commands.description: Validate model.conf syntax and required sections (request_definition, policy_definition, role_definition, policy_effect, matchers).
commands.title: Validate model.conf

commands.name: check_policy
commands.description: Check one policy line against a model: correct number of tokens per policy_definition.
commands.title: Check one policy line

commands.name: detect_duplicates
commands.description: Detect duplicate policy rules in policy.csv.
commands.title: Detect duplicate policy rules

commands.name: detect_role_cycle
commands.description: Detect inheritance cycles among g (role) rules.
commands.title: Detect role inheritance cycles

commands.name: explain_deny
commands.description: Explain step by step why an enforce(sub, obj, act) request is denied: which policies were considered, which matcher clauses failed.
commands.title: Explain why a request is denied

commands.name: diagnose
commands.description: Run the full check-up: model syntax, policy token counts, duplicates, role cycles, unreachable rules, and return an issue list with severity.
commands.title: Full configuration check-up

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate model.conf + policy.csv from a plain-language requirement description (supports common RBAC / restful / ABAC patterns).

requirement.description: Plain-language description, e.g. 'RBAC where admins manage everything and viewers only read reports'

commands.title: Generate config from plain language

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Diff two policy.csv files: added / removed / unchanged rules.
commands.title: Diff two policy files
